question: The passage is mainly focused on:

options.text: the effect of climate change on cyclone Nisarga
the frequency of cyclones in the Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal
the link of frequent cyclones with climate change

solution:
The correct answer is "**the link of frequent cyclones with climate change**"
